sources.label: Patch of things I daily use.
sources.author: Fakh
patch_list: Stops the Google Play license check from blocking the patched app with a "Get this app from Play" screen.
Draws the navigation bar as a floating, translucent capsule with a sliding selection pill, and the Create button above it as glass.
Uses your wallpaper's colors (Android 12+) in light and dark mode.
Turns the dark mode backgrounds black.
